main.title: Git Undo Explained: reset vs revert vs restore (with reflog recovery)
main.description:
Committed the wrong thing? Learn exactly what git restore, reset (soft/mixed/hard), revert and reflog do, which one is safe on shared branches, and how to answer this in a DevOps interview. Every command shown was run and checked in a real repository.

short.title: git reset: soft vs mixed vs hard in 30 seconds #Shorts
short.description:
All three move your branch back. Soft keeps changes staged, mixed keeps them unstaged, hard throws them away. Slipped? git reflog brings the commit back.

Practise it safely: https://github.com/jeevanm84/git-command-master-map
